title: Prophetic Welcoming Traditions for the Newborn
summary: The Prophetic tradition meticulously outlines spiritual and emotional milestones for welcoming a newborn: reciting the Adhan in the right ear so Tawheed is the very first message heard, gentle tahneek with a softened date, offering the Aqeeqah on the seventh day to spread joy, thank Allah, and release the newborn's pledge, shaving the head and giving silver in charity equal to its weight, choosing a good name befitting him, and the infant is fortified daily with al-Mu'awwidhat and prophetic supplications for protection and instilling tranquility in his soul.
try_this: This week: Prepare a list of authentic protective supplications (e.g., 'I seek refuge for you in the perfect words of Allah from every devil, poisonous pest, and evil eye') and make reciting them softly a peaceful daily routine during feeding or bedtime, with prior agreement on the name and the seventh-day sunnahs.
reflection_prompts: How do prophetic welcoming traditions instill spiritual belonging from day one?
Which welcoming Sunnah practices are you preparing to implement upon birth?
